Bash(the loopback address space" \(CORS/loopback security error\)
- This happens because Next.js bakes NEXT_PUBLIC_* variables into static files
  during build time, not runtime

Root Cause:
- NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL wasn''t set during Docker build
- Frontend was built with default value: http://localhost:8080
- This value was hardcoded into the frontend bundle

Solution:
1. Dockerfile.dev: Added ARG declarations for NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL, BASE_URL,
   and NODE_ENV to accept build-time arguments
2. docker-compose.oracle.yml: Added build.args to pass environment variables
   to the build process
3. Updated all .env.example files to include NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL with clear
   documentation about its importance
4. Updated .gitignore to allow *.example files while still blocking real secrets

Files Changed:
- Dockerfile.dev: Add ARG and ENV variables for build-time configuration
- docker-compose.oracle.yml: Add build args section
- .env.example: Add NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:8080
- .env.oracle.example: Add NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://trunc.site + JWT config
- .env.prod.example: Add NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://trunc.site
- .gitignore: Allow !.env.*.example files

Next Steps for Deployment:
1. Set BASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL in .env on Oracle server
2. Rebuild container with: docker-compose build --no-cache
3. Frontend will now call https://trunc.site/api/v1/... instead of localhost
